chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

key_terms.اللَّجَاجَةُ: Stubbornness, obstinacy, or persistence in one's view despite evidence.

ai.seo_question: What is the effect of stubbornness on good advice according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies stubbornness (lajājah) as a spiritual and intellectual vice that severs the connection to sound judgment (ra'y). This teaching is central to Shia ethical discourse, illustrating how obstinacy not only blocks the acceptance of beneficial advice but also corrupts the individual's internal capacity for discernment, a concept deeply rooted in the Quranic narrative of Pharaoh's refusal to heed counsel.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 179. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
